column1: # Native 53.16 PE world-site type productions, read from each edition's machine code.
# All addresses are RVAs. Steam formatter 0x10cbe50, jump table 0x10cc160;
# classic formatter 0x10c6dc0, jump table 0x10c70d0. Both have selectors 0..10.
# title: The [dark ][RAW race adjective ]type of name; compact: name, [dark ][RAW race adjective ]type.
# Dark prefix: Steam 0x10cbe10 / classic 0x10c6d80, only selector 1.
# Omit race for selector 10, missing governing entity, or entity.flags NON_RACIAL (0x400).
# classic 0x1c2072, 0x1c767f..0x1c77ad, 0x1ce8d6. A final pass capitalizes every title word.
# Abandoned/Ruined local-building captions come from separate adventure-map producers,
# not from this type formatter or its race/dark composition.
